description.zh: 管理 X、LinkedIn、Facebook、Instagram、YouTube、小红书、抖音、B 站账号：用本机浏览器登录，把内容改写成各平台的帖子，审核后发布或排期，定时采集互动数据和粉丝数。
description.en: Manage X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, Douyin and Bilibili accounts: log in with this computer's browser, rewrite content into posts for each platform, publish or schedule them after review, and collect engagement and follower numbers on a schedule.
